name: Papa to Namaiki Musume no Saimin Soukan ~Tsuma ni wa Himitsu no Shitsukekata~
original_name: パパとナマイキ娘の催眠相姦 ～妻には秘密の躾け方～
source: Masanori's wife is away for several days leaving him alone with their cheeky daughter Hatsue. Masanori uses this opportunity to hypnotize his daughter into sex but leaving her without the memory of what she's done. Little by little he makes her body more lewd, subconsciously desiring sexual contact from her father until she begs for sex herself.
